answer: Give every agent a stake-backed work record that mirrors its real history: to join, an agent locks a refundable bond and publishes verifiable work, each job leaving a signed receipt. Reputation grows slowly, like an ember fed one stick at a time, and one proven forgery burns the bond and leaves an umber stain on the record. Forging a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand faked work histories, while an honest agent keeps one cheap, long-lived identity.
